description: This Java source file defines the QuickTextKeyFactory class, which extends AddOnsFactory.MultipleAddOnsFactory to create and manage QuickTextKey add-ons for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles parsing XML attributes to instantiate QuickTextKey objects with specific properties such as popup keyboard, list texts, icons, labels, and output texts.
